name: Driving Simulator (CWC01 - All Bonus Features)
author: Zhiu_1234
description: In this racing game you can drive against your friend (or yourself) using local split screen. Try to evade the traffic and hit those boxes to make it harder for your opponent. If you don't like the camera, change it, by using the "1" / "2" or the "comma" / "dot" keys. In case you'll fall down the map, don't worry. You'll spawn back to the starting position. Now, have fun! :)
